More importantly, upgrading to hotels returns 8 houses to the bank, which only has 2 left — giving p4 the supply to finish developing Park Place and Boardwalk toward hotels, which would be far worse for me. Better to keep the house shortage intact and hold onto cash rather than unmortgage Illinois or the railroads for marginal rent gains, so I'll just end my turn.
